name: Promotion of Patriotism/National Integration/Communal Harmony - Production of Musical Programme or Tiatr
benefit:
- Remuneration as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa will be provided to the applicant.
- Reimbursement of actual charges of the hall/auditorium or payment of lump sum amount as fixed by Tiatr Academy of Goa if performance is held in makeshift pandal.
- Video recording of the activity/programme will be done by Tiatr Academy of Goa.
- One copy of the Digital Video Disc will be provided to the applicant.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be an individual/organization/educational institution/club. - The applicant must propose an activity that is a tiatr/musical programme on the theme of patriotism/national integration/communal harmony. - The applicant must ensure the duration of the musical programme or tiatr is not less than two hours. - The applicant must submit the application along with typed script/lyrics at least 30 days before the date of staging the programme. - The applicant must attach No Objection Certificate from the lyricist/writer/director concerned if they are not the lyricist/writer/director of the proposed activity. - The applicant must ensure scripts/lyrics do not contain any adverse remarks against any Governments/Individuals/Institutions or anything against caste, creed and religion.
